args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4.

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity) affects fastjson <2.9.4 (and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0) via unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. 2.9.4 is the fixed version in the 2.x line.

CI has passed on this branch.

2. **Created branch** `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` from `main`.
3. **Upgraded** `requirements.txt` from `fastjson==2.8.0` to `fastjson==2.9.4` and committed it.

5. **Opened PR #101** against `main` titled "Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337" and requested review from **alex** (confirmed as a reviewer).

The PR is open and awaiting review; I did not merge it since main is protected and requires code-owner approval.
